entities.title: The universe
entities.summary: Eight Reaches of 256 generated systems, distance and fuel range, choosing a destination and the charts.
entities.purpose: Works out every system from the generator of RULES A.3 with the GDD's data, measures distance and range (A.4), does the pure computations of choosing and reaching a destination (A.5) and the charts' behaviour (A.6).
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
Nothing here draws a random number.
The selected system, the cursor and the countdown are held by the hyperspace feature.
